evolution-v1.adoption: explicit; existing taskand-v1 consumers remain unchanged
evolution-v1.runtime_conformance: not implied by bundle validity or glm53 process URI version

requirements.title: Bound incident recovery without replaying uncertain effects
requirements.description: Keep incident identity and shared repair/no-progress budgets across restarts, prompts and descendants. Reconcile unknown effect outcomes before retries, quarantine regressing candidates, preserve every working layer and rehearse scoped repairs in a qualified twin. Watchers and evaluators grant no authority; the protected controller revalidates before each effect. Stop only the affected scope and escalate the concrete missing evidence or authority without creating new writers.

requirements.title: Bound delivery debt before further evolution
requirements.description: Before every continuation, allocation, governance activation and publication, observe the entire accepted-base delta and all working layers. Reconcile adoption and ownership first; finish or preserve pending delivery before growing the same scope. Use a closed, digest-bound observation and never infer remote publication or merge from local source, tests or snapshots.

requirements.title: Separate versioned requests, facts and authority
requirements.description: Evolution profile binds closed request-only DSL, payload, grammar and operation registry by immutable URI and digest. CloudEvents logs record facts and never authorize effects. Controller validates referenced schemas, scope and idempotency before one effect.

requirements.title: Bounded complementary evolution and multiplication
requirements.description: Reuse pinned qualified processes and twins first; allocate children atomically with no broader grants and decreasing shared budgets. Unknown twin behavior blocks dependent effects. Promotion requires Gate A/B evidence, independent exact-head approval and controller receipt; advisory LLM output cannot weaken policy.

requirements.title: Capsule manifest with processes[] and valid role
requirements.description: capsule.yaml must exist and define spec.role (application, orchestrator, worker, agent) and spec.processes list

requirements.title: URI to Directory Path bijection
requirements.description: Every URI proc://<org>/<ability>/<version> must map strictly to proc/<ability>/<org>/<version>/

requirements.title: Process directory triple (proc.yaml, bin.mjs, test.mjs)
requirements.description: Each process directory must contain proc.yaml declaration, executable bin.mjs, and test.mjs contract test

requirements.title: Standard Makefile Operational API
requirements.description: Makefile must implement: test, pack, verify, run, observe, extract, deploy, rollback, conformance

requirements.title: Cryptographic process catalog proc-catalog.json
requirements.description: proc-catalog.json must contain valid SHA-256 hashes matching bin.mjs and proc.yaml

requirements.title: Grants policy and prohibited baseline
requirements.description: grants.yaml must enforce deny list including policy-write, claims-delete, git-push, self-restart

requirements.title: Fail-Closed Contract (Exit codes 0, 1, 2)
requirements.description: Processes must consume JSON from stdin, output JSON to stdout, and exit with code 0 on success, 1 on runtime error, 2 on contract mismatch

requirements.title: Git versioning and immutable history
requirements.description: Package must reside in a git repository with tagged releases and branch protection

requirements.title: Evolution with delegated controller and Digital Twin
requirements.description: capsule.yaml must define evolution.delegated-to and twin retries limit

requirements.title: Zero Cross-Package code imports
requirements.description: Processes must communicate exclusively via URI runner and JSON IPC without cross-package import/require

delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-EFFECT: Read the existing operation receipt and exact remote state by idempotency key before considering another effect; a timeout is not proof of failure.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-REGRESSION: Freeze promotion of the affected candidate and preserve evidence; propose only an already authorized and tested rollback, never reset or discard work.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-AUTHORITY: Resolve the exact missing target, effect and authority; do not repeat generic approval requests or change policy to self-authorize.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-EXHAUSTED: Stop the affected writer and descendants; preserve state and issue one incident-linked escalation. Do not reset counters through a new prompt, ticket or node.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-PRESERVATION: Capture and verify restoration of index, working files, untracked material and unique history before repair.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-UNKNOWN: Retain a redacted source reference and diagnose the unrecognized failure; do not infer transient failure or successful recovery.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-TWIN-FAILED: Reject the failed repair rehearsal and preserve its evidence; no production retry or promotion follows a failed twin.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-TWIN: Reproduce the exact incident in an isolated, revision-bound twin with explicit coverage before proposing a repair effect.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-BACKOFF: Observe the persisted retry deadline; missing backoff evidence does not authorize immediate retry.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-RETRY: A retry candidate is not permission: revalidate idempotency, target state, scope, lease, shared budget and all controller gates before one attempt.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-RECOVERY-PLAN: Plan a bounded repair within accepted intent; resolve ownership and all failing gates before an independently controlled effect.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-INVALID: Reject malformed observations without echoing their contents; acquire a fresh closed observation.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-STALE: Reobserve Git, workspace, remote and controller against the current clock.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-OWNER: Resolve the actual owner and fencing; preserve unknown and concurrent work.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-ADOPTION: Reconcile the pre-adoption baseline and every affected checkout before activating policy; do not relabel history or disable gates.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-REMOTE: Observe the remote branch and PR; absence and failed lookup are different states.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-OVERLAP: Finish, hand off or serialize material debt in the overlapping scope; do not create another writer.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-BUDGET: Preserve all layers and split the complete outcome through the ticket lifecycle; do not enlarge the budget to hide debt.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-CONTROLLER: Restore or reconcile the declared protected delivery route; do not substitute a fake status or weaker review.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-PENDING: Complete or explicitly defer the existing delivery before starting a new slice in this scope.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-ACTIVATION: Qualify the clean adoption candidate and every clone-wide hook consumer before activation.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-VALIDATION: Preserve dirty state and validate the exact complete changeset; repair only within the accepted intent.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-AUTHORITY: Preserve the bounded outcome and resolve only genuinely missing publication authority.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-UNCOMMITTED: Stage the exact verified intent and material delta; commit with all applicable hooks enabled.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-UNPUSHED: Recheck authority and full-range gates, push only the ticket branch and read back its exact SHA.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-NO-PR: Reuse or open the matching ticket PR and verify its exact head; do not duplicate PRs.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-REVIEW: Keep the exact head frozen for independent protected review; never self-merge.
delivery_diagnostics.TKD-DELIVERY-BOUNDED: Continue only within current intent, scope, ownership and budgets; this result grants no authority.
